geometry_edits.rationale: Turn the public carve toward the verified access edge to make the ground response legible.
Reduce roof fragmentation and make the hall section read as a clearer daylight-bearing span.
Keep the primary hall stretched along the long axis so the dominant gesture remains legible.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early massing for a gymnasium: one dominant compact body, a legible carved void, and a folded/profiled roof section that suggests span rather than arbitrary sculpture. The four views are consistent enough and do not show obvious volumetric collisions. The public edge response is present but somewhat indirect; the access-side relation could be sharper, since the void is useful yet the frontage does not feel fully anchored to the verified road edge. Overall the form supports the requested compact training-hall brief better than a generic box, though it is still somewhat over-faceted and could benefit from a cleaner dominant mass and clearer access hierarchy.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Deepened edge and courtyard-like void can make a low sports volume feel public and legible.
A long, horizontal, low-rise bar with subtle entry recess is compatible with gym massing.
Terraced support platforms and a strong horizontal canopy can articulate a sports building without losing its main span.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Primary typology reads more club/cultural than gymnasium; use only the spatial principle, not the whole language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A clear linear bar with an open ground edge and auxiliary vertical element can still preserve hierarchy.
A recessed ground level and simple rectilinear upper mass can support public threshold and calm program legibility.

warnings: The dominant mass is slightly fragmented by multiple roof facets; keep the main hall more continuous in the next iteration.
Access-edge legibility is only moderate; strengthen the public threshold toward the verified frontage instead of relying on a centered void.
The silhouette is coherent, but some stepped/faceted changes read as over-modeled rather than capacity-driven.
